ayahs.translation: Ha'. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِیْنِۙۛ
ayahs.translation: By the Clear Book;

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰهُ قُرْءٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: verily We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you may understand.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهٗ فِیْۤ اُمِّ الْكِتٰبِ لَدَیْنَا لَعَلِیٌّ حَكِیْمٌؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed it is transcribed in the Original Book with Us; sublime and full of wisdom.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا اَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Should We divert this Good Counsel from you because you are a people immersed in extravagance?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَمْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَّبِیٍّ فِی الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: How many a Prophet did We send to the earlier peoples!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یَاْتِیْهِمْ مِّنْ نَّبِیٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Yet never did a Prophet come to them but they mocked him.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَهْلَكْنَاۤ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَّ مَضٰى مَثَلُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We utterly destroyed them although they were greater in might than these. The examples of ancient peoples have gone before.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ لَیَقُوْلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِیْزُ الْعَلِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: Yet if you were to ask them: “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they will certainly say: “The All-Mighty, the All-Knowing has created them.”

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَّ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who made this earth for you a cradle and made in it pathways for you that you may find the way to your destination;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ١ۚ فَاَنْشَرْنَا بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّیْتًا١ۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He Who sent down water from the sky in a determined measure, and thereby We revived a dead land: likewise will you be raised up (from the earth) --

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَ الْاَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: He Who created these pairs, all of them, and provided you ships and cattle on which you ride,

ayahs.arabicText: لِتَسْتَوٗا عَلٰى ظُهُوْرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ اِذَا اسْتَوَیْتُمْ عَلَیْهِ وَ تَقُوْلُوْا سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِیْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَ مَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: so that when you are mounted upon them you may remember the bounty of your Lord, and say: “Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to Us whereas we did not have the strength to subdue it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is to our Lord that we shall eventually return.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلُوْا لَهٗ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ جُزْءًا١ؕ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُوْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌؕ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Yet they have made some of His servants a part of Him. Indeed man is most evidently thankless.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا یَخْلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّ اَصْفٰىكُمْ بِالْبَنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Has Allah taken for Himself daughters out of those whom He creates and has chosen you to have sons?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهٗ مُسْوَدًّا وَّ هُوَ كَظِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: (They believe so although when) any of them is given tidings of the birth of a female child the like of which he assigns to the Merciful One, his countenance darkens and he is choked with grief.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ مَنْ یُّنَشَّؤُا فِی الْحِلْیَةِ وَ هُوَ فِی الْخِصَامِ غَیْرُ مُبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Do they assign to Allah one who grows up amidst ornaments and is not well-versed in the art of disputation?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلُوا الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ عِبٰدُ الرَّحْمٰنِ اِنَاثًا١ؕ اَشَهِدُوْا خَلْقَهُمْ١ؕ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَ یُسْئَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They claim that angels, who are Allah's chosen servants, are females. Did they witness how their body is constituted? Their testimony shall be written and they shall be called to account.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَآءَ الرَّحْمٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنٰهُمْ١ؕ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ١ۗ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا یَخْرُصُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: They say: “Had the Merciful One so willed, we would never have worshipped these deities.” But they have no knowledge of the matter and are simply conjecturing.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ اٰتَیْنٰهُمْ كِتٰبًا مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ فَهُمْ بِهٖ مُسْتَمْسِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or did We bestow upon them a Book before on whose authority they are holding on (to angel-worship)?

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰۤى اُمَّةٍ وَّ اِنَّا عَلٰۤى اٰثٰرِهِمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Nay; they simply claim: “We found our forefathers on a way, and we continue to find guidance in their footsteps.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِیْ قَرْیَةٍ مِّنْ نَّذِیْرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوْهَاۤ١ۙ اِنَّا وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰۤى اُمَّةٍ وَّ اِنَّا عَلٰۤى اٰثٰرِهِمْ مُّقْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And thus it is: whenever We sent any warner to a city its affluent ones said: “We found our forefathers on a way and we continue to follow in their footsteps.”

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ اَوَ لَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاَهْدٰى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُّمْ عَلَیْهِ اٰبَآءَكُمْ١ؕ قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Each Prophet asked them: “Will you do so even if we were to show you a way better than the way of your forefathers?” They answered: “We disbelieve in the religion with which you have been sent.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Then We exacted retribution from them. So do consider the end of those who gave the lie (to the Prophets).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِیْمُ لِاَبِیْهِ وَ قَوْمِهٖۤ اِنَّنِیْ بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Call to mind when Abraham said to his father and his people: “I totally disown all whom you serve

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا الَّذِیْ فَطَرَنِیْ فَاِنَّهٗ سَیَهْدِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: except the One Who created me; and, behold, it is He Who will direct me to the Right Way.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِیَةً فِیْ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Abraham left behind this word to endure among his posterity so that they may return to it.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ وَ اٰبَآءَهُمْ حَتّٰى جَآءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَ رَسُوْلٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: (Even when they began worshipping others than Allah We did not destroy them) but bestowed sustenance on them and on their forefathers until there came to them the Truth and a Messenger who clearly expounded things to them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَّ اِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when the Truth came to them they said: “This is just sorcery and we reject it.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْ لَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْیَتَیْنِ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: They say: “Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon some great man from the two (main) cities?”

ayahs.arabicText: اَهُمْ یَقْسِمُوْنَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ١ؕ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَیْنَهُمْ مَّعِیْشَتَهُمْ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا وَ رَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّیَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِیًّا١ؕ وَ رَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَیْرٌ مِّمَّا یَجْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Is it they who distribute the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who have distributed their livelihood among them in the life of this world, and have raised some above others in rank that some of them may harness others to their service. Your Lord's Mercy is better than all the treasures that they hoard.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ یَّكُوْنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ یَّكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمٰنِ لِبُیُوْتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّ مَعَارِجَ عَلَیْهَا یَظْهَرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Were it not that all mankind would become a single community (and follow the same way), We would have provided for all those who disbelieve in the Merciful One silver roofs for their houses, and (silver) stairs on which to go up,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِبُیُوْتِهِمْ اَبْوَابًا وَّ سُرُرًا عَلَیْهَا یَتَّكِئُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and (silver) doors to their houses, and couches (of silver) upon which they would recline;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ زُخْرُفًا١ؕ وَ اِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ؕ وَ الْاٰخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: or that they be made of gold. Surely all this is only the enjoyment of the life of the world. But (true prosperity) in the Hereafter with Your Lord is only for the God-fearing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ نُقَیِّضْ لَهٗ شَیْطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: He who is negligent to remember the Merciful One, to him We assign a satan as his boon companion,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَیَصُدُّوْنَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِیْلِ وَ یَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and these satans hinder them from the Right Path, while he still reckons himself to be rightly-guided.

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ یٰلَیْتَ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَیْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: But when he comes to Us, he will say (to his satan): “Would that there had been between me and you the distance as between the East and the West. How evil a companion you were!”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَنْ یَّنْفَعَكُمُ الْیَوْمَ اِذْ ظَّلَمْتُمْ اَنَّكُمْ فِی الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (He will then be told): “Today it will not benefit you the least that after your wrong-doing you and your satans now share the chastisement.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَاَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوْ تَهْدِی الْعُمْیَ وَ مَنْ كَانَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Can you, (O Prophet), then make the deaf hear, or direct to the Right Way the blind or one lost in manifest error?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُّنْتَقِمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: We shall inflict retribution on them, whether We take you away from the world (before We do that),

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ نُرِیَنَّكَ الَّذِیْ وَعَدْنٰهُمْ فَاِنَّا عَلَیْهِمْ مُّقْتَدِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: or make you see the end that We had promised them, for We have full power over them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِیْۤ اُوْحِیَ اِلَیْكَ١ۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Surely you are on the Straight Way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهٗ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَ لِقَوْمِكَ١ۚ وَ سَوْفَ تُسْئَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Verily it is a great source of eminence for you and your people, and soon you will be called to account concerning that.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ سْئَلْ مَنْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُّسُلِنَاۤ اَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً یُّعْبَدُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Ask all Our Messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed any deities beside the Merciful One to be worshipped.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَاۡئِهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed We sent Moses with Our Signs to Pharaoh and his nobles. He told them: “I am a Messenger of the Lord of the Universe.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا یَضْحَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Yet when he brought forth Clear Signs from Us, then lo, they burst into laughter.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا نُرِیْهِمْ مِّنْ اٰیَةٍ اِلَّا هِیَ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ اُخْتِهَا١٘ وَ اَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Every Sign that We showed them was greater than its predecessor; and then We seized them with Our chastisement so that they may return (to the Right Way).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا یٰۤاَیُّهَ السّٰحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ١ۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Whenever they faced an affliction) they would say: “O magician, pray for us to your Lord according to your station with Him. We shall certainly be guided to the Right Way.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمْ یَنْكُثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But lo, each time We removed Our affliction from them, they would go back on their word.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَادٰى فِرْعَوْنُ فِیْ قَوْمِهٖ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَلَیْسَ لِیْ مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَ هٰذِهِ الْاَنْهٰرُ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِیْ١ۚ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people: “My people, do I not have dominion over Egypt, and are these streams not flowing beneath me? Can't you see?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ اَنَا خَیْرٌ مِّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِیْ هُوَ مَهِیْنٌ١ۙ۬ وَّ لَا یَكَادُ یُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: Am I better or this contemptible man who is scarcely able to express himself?

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْ لَاۤ اُلْقِیَ عَلَیْهِ اَسْوِرَةٌ مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ اَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Why were bracelets of gold not bestowed upon him? Why did a retinue of angels not accompany him as attendants?”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوْهُ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He incited his people to levity and they obeyed him. Surely they were an iniquitous people.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّاۤ اٰسَفُوْنَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So when they incurred Our wrath, We exacted retribution from them, and drowned them all,

ayahs.arabicText: فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَّ مَثَلًا لِّلْاٰخِرِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and made them a thing of the past and an example for those who would come after them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْیَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ یَصِدُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: No sooner the example of the son of Mary was mentioned than, lo and behold, your people raised a clamour

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَیْرٌ اَمْ هُوَ١ؕ مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا١ؕ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and said: “Who is better, our deities or he?” They said so only out of contentiousness. They are a disputatious people.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبْدٌ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَیْهِ وَ جَعَلْنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: He was no more than a servant (of Ours), one upon whom We bestowed Our favours and whom We made an example (of Our infinite power) for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَّلٰٓئِكَةً فِی الْاَرْضِ یَخْلُفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If We had so willed We could have made some of you into angels to become your successors on earth.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَ اتَّبِعُوْنِ١ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Verily he [i.e., Jesus) is a portent of the Hour. So be in no doubt concerning it and follow Me. This is the Straight Way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّیْطٰنُ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Let not Satan hinder you (from believing in the Hour), for surely he is your open enemy.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ عِیْسٰى بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَ لِاُبَیِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِیْ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ فِیْهِ١ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: When Jesus came with Clear Signs and said: “I have brought wisdom to you that I may make plain to you some of the things you differ about. So fear Allah and follow me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّیْ وَ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ١ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore, serve Him. That is the Straight Way.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَیْنِهِمْ١ۚ فَوَیْلٌ لِّلَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْ عَذَابِ یَوْمٍ اَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Then the factions fell apart among themselves. So woe to the wrong-doers from the chastisement of a grievous Day.

ayahs.arabicText: هَلْ یَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنْ تَاْتِیَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَّ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Are they awaiting anything other than the Last Hour that it should suddenly come upon them without their even perceiving it?

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْاَخِلَّآءُ یَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الْمُتَّقِیْنَؕ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: On that Day even bosom friends shall become enemies to one another, all except the God-fearing.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَیْكُمُ الْیَوْمَ وَ لَاۤ اَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: (It will be said to them): “My servants, today you have nothing to fear or regret,

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ كَانُوْا مُسْلِمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: you who believed in Our Signs and had surrendered yourselves (to Us)!

ayahs.arabicText: اُدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ اَنْتُمْ وَ اَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Enter Paradise joyfully, both you and your spouses.”

ayahs.arabicText: یُطَافُ عَلَیْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّ اَكْوَابٍ١ۚ وَ فِیْهَا مَا تَشْتَهِیْهِ الْاَنْفُسُ وَ تَلَذُّ الْاَعْیُنُ١ۚ وَ اَنْتُمْ فِیْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Platters and cups of gold shall be passed around them, and there shall be all that they might desire and all that their eyes might delight in. (They shall be told): “Herein shall you abide for ever.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِیْۤ اُوْرِثْتُمُوْهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Such is the Paradise that you shall inherit by virtue of your good deeds in the life of the world.

ayahs.arabicText: لَكُمْ فِیْهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِیْرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Herein you will have abundant fruits of which you will eat.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ فِیْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: But the evil-doers shall abide in the torment of Hell.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَ هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Never will their torment be lightened for them. They shall remain in utter despair.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is not We Who wronged them; rather, it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَادَوْا یٰمٰلِكُ لِیَقْضِ عَلَیْنَا رَبُّكَ١ؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ مّٰكِثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They shall call out: “O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us.” He will reply: “You must stay on in it.

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ جِئْنٰكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كٰرِهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We brought you the Truth; but to the truth most of you were averse.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ اَبْرَمُوْۤا اَمْرًا فَاِنَّا مُبْرِمُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Have they contrived some scheme? If so, We too will contrive a scheme.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَ نَجْوٰىهُمْ١ؕ بَلٰى وَ رُسُلُنَا لَدَیْهِمْ یَكْتُبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and their whispering counsels? Yes, indeed We do and Our messengers [i.e., angels) are with them, writing.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ وَلَدٌ١ۖۗ فَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الْعٰبِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: “If the Merciful One had a son, I would have been the first one to worship him.”

ayahs.arabicText: سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا یَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Exalted be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above what they attribute to Him.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ یَخُوْضُوْا وَ یَلْعَبُوْا حَتّٰى یُلٰقُوْا یَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِیْ یُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So leave them alone to indulge in their vanities and to frolic about until they encounter that Day of theirs against which they have been warned.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ فِی السَّمَآءِ اِلٰهٌ وَّ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلٰهٌ١ؕ وَ هُوَ الْحَكِیْمُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who is God in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Wise, the All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا١ۚ وَ عِنْدَهٗ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ١ۚ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He Who has dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and to Him you shall all be sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَمْلِكُ الَّذِیْنَ یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ هُمْ یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those whom they call upon, instead of Allah have no power of intercession, except such that testify to the truth based on knowledge.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَیَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰى یُؤْفَكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: If you were to ask them: “Who created them?” they will surely say: “Allah.” Whence are they, then, being led astray?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِیْلِهٖ یٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا یُؤْمِنُوْنَۘ
ayahs.translation: We call to witness the cry of the Messenger: “O Lord, these are a people not wont to believe!”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَ قُلْ سَلٰمٌ١ؕ فَسَوْفَ یَعْلَمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Indulge them, (O Prophet), and say to them: “Peace to you.” For soon they shall come to know.
